comment: The Title Case default labels (definition id -> label) that nodes saved before the copy sweep carry. They no longer equal the definition's name, but they are still the default title, not a name the person chose. backend/services/node_route.py FORMER_DEFAULT_TITLES and frontend/src/lib/formerDefaultTitles.ts both hold this table; backend/tests/test_former_default_titles.py and frontend/tests/lib/formerDefaultTitles.test.ts pin each to this file.
